plugins.name: golang-architecture
plugins.description: Forces Go-idiomatic package boundaries and dependency direction for backend modules: domain/business-logic packages never import a concrete infrastructure package directly, ports are interfaces declared by the consumer package, and every concrete adapter is constructed in one composition root.

plugins.name: frontend-ui-architecture
plugins.description: Defines where frontend code lives and how it's layered: folder/feature structure, component-folder anatomy, component splitting, constants placement, utils vs helpers vs services, business-logic placement, types organization, and barrel-file conventions for plain React and Next.js App Router apps.

plugins.name: marketplace-release
plugins.description: Publishes a skill or agent to the redfoxius/claude-skills-marketplace repo: scaffolding a new plugin's plugin.json/SKILL.md-or-agents-file/marketplace.json entry, or running scripts/release_skill.py to verify version agreement, zip, tag, publish a GitHub Release, and update the README's release link for an existing one.

plugins.name: architecture-reviewer
plugins.description: Read-only agent that reviews a diff, PR, branch, or directory for architectural-boundary violations, routing each touched file to the right architecture skill and citing every finding to file:line. Never edits code.

plugins.name: doc-writer
plugins.description: Turns an already-implemented feature (plan doc, PR, or commit range) into feature-facing reference/explanation documentation with Mermaid diagrams, linking out to existing docs instead of duplicating them.

plugins.name: implementer
plugins.description: Executes an already-written Development Plan across frontend and backend packages, applying the relevant project skills per file and self-verifying with each package's test/typecheck commands.

plugins.name: plan-verifier
plugins.description: Checks already-finished code against every point of a Development Plan and its Implementation Report, producing a MET/NOT MET/UNVERIFIABLE verdict per criterion backed by file:line evidence or real command output.

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: Turns a feature/bugfix request into a structured Development Plan, reading each touched module's architectural constraints and gotchas so the plan can't contradict rules the implementer will later be bound by.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: Read-only research agent for repository and external investigation — finds existing code, patterns, or history, or looks up documentation, always backing findings with file:line or source citations.

plugins.name: test-writer
plugins.description: Writes or extends tests for UI and backend code, applying each package's own test conventions and always running the real test command to self-verify. Only touches test files, never production code.
